item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.3.1

SupaSidebar 1.3.1 improves bookmark imports and tab restore reliability, with a few small refinements to the sidebar and Space settings.

Bug Fixes

  • Browser Reattachment Crash: Fixed a crash that could occur when the sidebar reconnects to a browser while its window information is changing.
  • Find More Browser Bookmarks: Chromium-based browser imports now read both local and account bookmark stores, so recently added bookmarks in a browser profile are included when available on your Mac.
  • More Complete Firefox and Zen Imports: Imports include Mobile Bookmarks and read a consistent snapshot of the browser’s saved bookmarks, including recent changes while the browser is running.
  • Clearer Import Errors: Malformed Safari bookmark files are reported as invalid data. Unsupported encrypted Chromium bookmark stores produce an error instead of silently leaving bookmarks out.
  • Safer Tab Restore: Space switching waits for fresh browser tab data before saving or closing outgoing tabs. Incomplete reads are retried, and unreadable tab data stops the operation with a message instead of replacing saved tabs with incomplete information.
  • Keep Your Browser Order: Your custom Live Tabs browser order is preserved while tabs refresh during a Space restore.

Improvements

  • Quick Recents Control: A compact switch beside Recents takes you back to Live Tabs. Clicking the Recents title still collapses or expands the section.
  • Simpler Space Settings: Unlinked Spaces show the browser/profile picker first. Connection details appear after you link a browser or profile.

item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0-beta.2

What’s New

  • Updated Onboarding: New setups now use a browser-aware flow that helps you choose useful sites, configure how SupaSidebar opens, and reach your first working sidebar faster.
  • Search Settings: Find preferences from one search field, jump directly to the right section, and change supported toggles from the results.
  • Scoped Search Shortcuts: Assign optional shortcuts that open the Command Panel directly in the Live Tabs or Saved scope.
  • Precise Auto-Close Duration: Choose a custom timeout using any combination of days, hours, and minutes.
  • Local Folder Preview Sorting: Order files and subfolders by Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Date Modified Newest, or Date Modified Oldest. Name sorting handles numbered files naturally, so Export 2 appears before Export 10.

Improvements

  • Smart Attach Stays in Sync: The menu and Preferences now agree with the sidebar’s actual attachment mode.
  • Sidebar Size and Position Are Remembered: A sidebar you move or resize returns to the same position and height after relaunching SupaSidebar.
  • Auto-Show Is Opt-In for New Setups: The sidebar does not appear automatically when you focus a browser unless you enable Auto Show on Browser Focus.
  • Command Panel shortcut hints now adapt better when the panel has limited space.

Bug Fixes

  • Live Tabs search no longer hides an open tab when the same URL is also saved in SupaSidebar.
  • Dragging a link or folder into a folder no longer moves the entire sidebar window.

Notes

  • Local Folder Preview Sorting applies to Finder-style folder preview columns. It does not rearrange your saved SupaSidebar folders.
